auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Detrack API key sent with the X-API-KEY header. Generate or view it under Integrations > API Key: https://help.detrack.com/en/articles/6553302-how-to-generate-your-api-key.

actions.name: create_job
actions.description: Create a delivery or collection job in Detrack API V2.

doNumber.description: The D.O. number for the job. Detrack may allow automatic generation when configured, but this action requires an explicit stable identifier.

date.description: The date when the job is performed in YYYY-MM-DD format.

address.description: The address where the job is performed.

startDate.description: The date when the job starts in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timeWindowFrom.description: The beginning of the requested job time window.

timeWindowTo.description: The end of the requested job time window.

jobTime.description: The estimated duration needed to complete the job.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number associated with the job.

orderNumber.description: The customer order number associated with the job.

addressLatitude.description: The latitude of the job address.

addressLongitude.description: The longitude of the job address.

companyName.description: The company name at the job address.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the job address.

city.description: The city of the job address.

state.description: The state or province of the job address.

country.description: The country of the job address.

contactName.description: The person receiving the delivery or providing the collection.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number for the job.

assignTo.description: The driver or vehicle assignment name.

notifyEmail.description: One notification email address or multiple addresses separated by semicolons.

webhookUrl.description: The webhook URL associated with this job.

zone.description: The operational zone assigned to the job.

customer.description: The customer name associated with the job.

accountNumber.description: The customer account number associated with the job.

invoiceNumber.description: The invoice number associated with the job.

invoiceAmount.description: The invoice amount associated with the job.

groupName.description: The Detrack group assigned to the job.

boxes.description: A description of the boxes for the job.

runNumber.description: The run number assigned to the job.

remarks.description: Free-form remarks associated with the job.

serviceType.description: The service type assigned to the job.

vehicleType.description: The vehicle type required for the job.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit of the item.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The purchase order number of the item.

batchNumber.description: The batch number of the item.

expiryDate.description: The item expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

quantity.description: The planned quantity of the item.

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for the item.

weight.description: The planned weight of the item.

items.description: An item serial number.

serialNumbers.description: Serial numbers assigned to the item.
